example.el: Δεν αξίζει να αναλώνεις τον χρόνο σου σε τέτοιες συζητήσεις.
example.en: It's not worth spending your time on discussions like these.

why: Example showed only the passive sense; first sense is active 'spend, use up'.

example.el: Πρόκειται για κραυγαλέα παραβίαση του νόμου.
example.en: This is a blatant violation of the law.

why: Example illustrated the minor 'sensationalist' sense, not the first sense 'glaring, blatant'.

example.en: A biting north wind is blowing outside.

why: Example illustrated the colloquial 'pricey' sense, not the first sense 'biting (cold)'.

example.el: Στις διοφαντικές εξισώσεις αναζητούμε μόνο ακέραιες λύσεις.
example.en: In Diophantine equations we look only for integer solutions.

why: Original was factually wrong: a Diophantine equation is one whose integer solutions are sought, not one that has only integer solutions.

example.el: Από τότε που έφυγαν τα παιδιά του, ο παππούς μαράζωσε.
example.en: Since his children left, grandpa has been pining away.

why: Example illustrated the minor 'wither' (plant) sense, not the first sense 'waste away, pine'.

example.el: Η πύκνωση των υδρατμών σχηματίζει τα σύννεφα.
example.en: The condensation of water vapour forms clouds.

why: Example illustrated the minor 'increased frequency' sense, not the first sense 'condensation'.

example.el: Τα συνθήματα έχουν συχνά ομοιοτέλευτο για να τα θυμόμαστε εύκολα.
example.en: Slogans often have rhyming endings so that we remember them easily.

why: Grammar error: 'για να θυμούνται' made the slogans the ones remembering; it needs an object pronoun and a person subject.

example.el: Αν δεν βγει κυβέρνηση, θα ξαναψηφίσουμε τον Ιούνιο.
example.en: If no government is formed, we'll vote again in June.

why: Example illustrated the minor 'pass a bill again' sense, not the first sense 'vote again'.

example.el: Οσαδήποτε χρήματα κι αν σου προσφέρουν, μην το πουλήσεις.
example.en: However much money they offer you, don't sell it.

why: Example showed only the secondary adverbial use; replaced with the pronoun use (first sense).

example.en: The word "χελώνα" (turtle) is an epicene noun.

why: Wrong term: «γιατρός» is κοινού γένους (ο/η); επίκοινα have one gender for both sexes (η χελώνα, ο σκίουρος).

example.el: Προσπάθησε να τον φιλοτιμήσει για να βοηθήσει κι αυτός.
example.en: She tried to appeal to his sense of honour so that he would help too.

why: Example showed only the passive φιλοτιμούμαι; first sense is active 'appeal to someone's sense of honour'.
